notes: Three horror mods, converted to run here: The Man From The Fog, Cave Dweller and From The Fog. Find them in Mods under Converted - their own models, animations, sounds and jumpscares.
The horror server is on play.attob.lol when it's running: it only lets you in with all three horror mods turned on, and tells you which ones you're missing.
Items with their own models (CustomModelData, as 1.14+ servers use) now show them - From The Fog's Herobrine is built that way.
